● Intermediate

Paste your email's HTML and check it against common accessibility pitfalls — missing image alt text, vague link text, undersized fonts, poor colour contrast, and broken heading order.

How it works: The checker reads the HTML you paste. Font sizes and colours are checked where they're set inline (style="…"), as most email HTML is; styles in a <style> block or an external stylesheet aren't applied. Contrast is measured against WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text (24px, or 18.7px bold). It catches common problems, but it isn't a full audit: test with a screen reader before you send.
